crossRefs.note: From there they traveled to Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of brooks of water.

people.name: Bene-jaakan
people.line: Israelite encampment during the wilderness wanderings.

people.name: Hor-haggidgad
people.line: An Israelite campsite during the wilderness wanderings

translations.web: They traveled from Bene Jaakan, and encamped in Hor Haggidgad.
translations.bsb: They set out from Bene-jaakan and camped at Hor-haggidgad.
translations.kjv: And they removed from Benejaakan, and encamped at Horhagidgad.
translations.asv: And they journeyed from Bene-jaakan, and encamped in Hor-haggidgad.
